patterns.pattern: Assertion-reason with a numeric tangent length
patterns.sample: A: A point $10$ cm from the centre of a circle of radius $6$ cm has a tangent of length $8$ cm. R: The tangent is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

patterns.pattern: Assertion-reason on an angle claim at the chord of contact

patterns.pattern: Radius or tangent length by Pythagoras, with working
patterns.sample: A point $P$ is $25$ cm from the centre of a circle, and the tangent from $P$ has length $24$ cm. Find the radius.

patterns.pattern: Spot the error: test whether a claimed tangent length is possible
patterns.sample: For a circle of radius $5$ cm and a point $Q$ at $13$ cm from the centre, a student claims the tangent from $Q$ is $11$ cm long. Is this possible? Justify.

patterns.pattern: Shortest distance from an external point to the circle
patterns.sample: A boat $P$ is $12$ km along a tangent from the point $T$ on a circular island of radius $5$ km. Find the shortest distance from the boat to the island.

patterns.pattern: Justify whether alternate angles at tangents on a diameter are equal
patterns.sample: $AB$ and $CD$ are tangents at the ends of a diameter $AC$ of a circle of radius $5$ cm. Is $\angle BAC = \angle DCA$? Justify.

patterns.pattern: Centre distance and area of the radius-tangent triangle
patterns.sample: $PT$ touches a circle with centre $O$ and radius $9$ cm at $T$, and $PT = 12$ cm. Find $OP$ and the area of $\triangle OTP$.

patterns.pattern: Case study: roads or paths touching a circular region
patterns.sample: A road touches a circular lake of radius $30$ m at $T$; kiosk $P$ is $40$ m from $T$; another road from $P$ touches at $S$. (i) $\angle OTP$ (ii) $OP$ (iii) $PS$ and the area of $OTPS$.

patterns.pattern: Case study: throw along a tangent, solved with trigonometry
patterns.sample: A discus leaves a circle of radius $2$ m along tangent $AB$, with $\angle ABO = 30^\circ$. (i) $\angle OAB$ (ii) $OB$ (iii) $AB$.

patterns.pattern: Perimeter of a figure closed by a third tangent
patterns.sample: Tangents $PA$, $PB$ each have length $10$ cm. A tangent at a point on the minor arc meets them at $Q$, $R$. The perimeter of $\triangle PQR$ is:

patterns.pattern: Assertion-reason on equal tangents and their angles
patterns.sample: A: Tangents from a point $13$ cm from the centre subtend equal angles at the centre. R: Tangents from an external point to a circle are equal in length.

patterns.pattern: Central angle from the angle between tangents, with working
patterns.sample: Tangents $AB$, $AC$ touch a circle with centre $O$. If $\angle BAC = 70^\circ$, find $\angle BOC$.

patterns.pattern: Angle between radius and contact chord, with working
patterns.sample: Tangents $PA$, $PB$ touch a circle with centre $O$. If $\angle APB = 50^\circ$, find $\angle OAB$.

patterns.pattern: Tangent length from the radius and the angle between tangents, with working
patterns.sample: Two tangents to a circle of radius $6$ cm are inclined at $60^\circ$. Find the length of each tangent.

patterns.pattern: Chord of contact from the radius and centre distance
patterns.sample: Tangents $PA$, $PB$ are drawn from $P$, $10$ cm from the centre of a circle of radius $6$ cm. Find the length of chord $AB$.

patterns.pattern: Algebraic base angles of the tangent triangle, then the central angle
patterns.sample: Tangents $PA$, $PB$ touch a circle with centre $O$. If $\angle PAB = (3x + 5)^\circ$ and $\angle PBA = (5x - 25)^\circ$, find $x$ and $\angle AOB$.

patterns.pattern: Trigonometric value from the angle between tangents
patterns.sample: Tangents $TP$, $TQ$ touch a circle with centre $O$, $\angle OPQ = 15^\circ$ and $\angle PTQ = \theta$. Find $\sin 2\theta$.

patterns.pattern: Tangent length when tangents meet at the ends of a given chord
patterns.sample: A chord of length $16$ cm lies in a circle of radius $10$ cm. Tangents at its ends meet at $T$. Find the length of each tangent.

patterns.pattern: Tangent length when tangents meet at the ends of a chord, long form
patterns.sample: A chord $PQ = 24$ cm lies in a circle of radius $15$ cm. Tangents at $P$, $Q$ meet at $T$. Find the distance of $T$ from the chord, and $TP$.

patterns.pattern: Third tangent at the point where OP cuts the circle: find its length and a portion
patterns.sample: $P$ is $17$ cm from the centre $O$ of a circle of radius $8$ cm. The tangent at $C$, where $OP$ meets the circle, cuts the tangents from $P$ at $A$, $B$. Find $AB$ and $PA$.

patterns.pattern: Angle between tangent and chord against the central angle on that chord

patterns.sample: $PA$ touches a circle with centre $O$ at $A$, and the secant $PBC$ contains the diameter $BC$. If $\angle AOC = 110^\circ$, find $\angle APB$.

patterns.pattern: Show a stated base angle when the centre distance is twice the radius
patterns.sample: Tangents $PT$, $PS$ touch a circle with centre $O$ and radius $r$, with $OP = 2r$. Show that $\angle OTS = \angle OST = 30^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Chord parallel to the tangent at a given distance
patterns.sample: In a circle of radius $5$ cm, a chord is parallel to the tangent at $A$ and $2$ cm from $A$. Find the length of the chord.

patterns.pattern: Tangent meeting a produced diameter: find two angles
patterns.sample: Tangent $PC$ touches a circle at $C$, and diameter $AOB$ produced meets it at $P$. If $\angle PCA = 110^\circ$, find $\angle CBA$ and $\angle BCO$.

patterns.pattern: Touching circles: tangent from one centre to the other circle

patterns.pattern: Chord of the outer circle touching the inner circle, with working
patterns.sample: Concentric circles have radii $25$ cm and $7$ cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller one.

patterns.pattern: Prove the contact point bisects the chord, then find its length
patterns.sample: A chord $AB$ of the larger of two concentric circles touches the smaller at $P$. Prove $AP = PB$. Hence find $AB$ if the radii are $15$ cm and $9$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Tangent lengths from one point to two concentric circles
patterns.sample: Concentric circles have radii $5$ cm and $3$ cm. A tangent from $T$ to the larger circle has length $12$ cm. Find the length of the tangent from $T$ to the smaller circle.

patterns.pattern: Prove tangents at the ends of a diameter are parallel
patterns.sample: $AB$ is a diameter of a circle with centre $O$, of length $10$ cm. Prove that the tangents at $A$ and $B$ are parallel.

patterns.pattern: Prove the quadrilateral formed by P, the contact points and the centre is cyclic
patterns.sample: Tangents $PQ$, $PR$ touch a circle with centre $O$, and $\angle QPR = 50^\circ$. Prove that $PQOR$ is cyclic and find $\angle QOR$.

patterns.pattern: Prove that perpendicular tangents or radii give a square
patterns.sample: Tangents $PQ$, $PR$ touch a circle with centre $O$, and $\angle OPR = 45^\circ$. Prove that $ORPQ$ is a square.

patterns.pattern: Prove the sum of tangents equals OP for a 120 degree angle
patterns.sample: Tangents $PX$, $PY$ touch a circle with centre $O$, and $\angle XPY = 120^\circ$. Prove that $PX + PY = PO$.

patterns.pattern: Prove OP is the perpendicular bisector of the contact chord
patterns.sample: Tangents $PA$, $PB$ touch a circle with centre $O$. Prove that $OP$ bisects $AB$ at right angles, and find $AB$ if $PA = 8$ cm and $OA = 6$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Prove a product relation on a chord produced to P
patterns.sample: $C$ is the midpoint of chord $AB = 6$ cm, produced to $P$ with $PA = 4$ cm. Prove $PA \cdot PB = PC^2 - AC^2$ in general, and verify it for these lengths.

patterns.pattern: Prove the equal-tangents theorem
patterns.sample: Prove that the two tangents drawn to a circle from an external point are equal in length.

patterns.pattern: Prove the tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the contact point
patterns.sample: Prove that the tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

patterns.pattern: Prove the angle between tangents is twice the angle between radius and chord
patterns.sample: Tangents $TP$, $TQ$ touch a circle with centre $O$. Prove that $\angle PTQ = 2\angle OPQ$, and find $\angle OPQ$ if $\angle PTQ = 64^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Prove the angle between tangents and the central angle are supplementary
patterns.sample: Prove that the angle between two tangents from an external point and the angle subtended at the centre by the contact points sum to $180^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Prove a third tangent between parallel tangents subtends a right angle at the centre
patterns.sample: $XY$ and $X_1Y_1$ are parallel tangents to a circle with centre $O$. A third tangent meets them at $A$, $B$. Prove that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Prove tangents at the ends of a chord make equal angles with it
patterns.sample: Prove that the tangents at the ends of a chord of a circle make equal angles with that chord.

patterns.pattern: Prove an angle or length relation from a tangent with an inscribed angle
patterns.sample: $AB$ is a diameter and $PQ$ is the tangent at $C$, with $\angle ACP$ acute. Prove $\angle BAC + \angle ACP = 90^\circ$, and find $\angle ACP$ if $\angle BAC = 35^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: State and prove the equal-tangents theorem, then use it for a linked result
patterns.sample: Prove that tangents from an external point are equal. Use this to prove that a parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus, and find its side if the perimeter is $40$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Multi-step proof using a diameter circle or touching circles
patterns.sample: A circle on leg $AB$ of $\triangle ABC$, right-angled at $B$, as diameter meets $AC$ at $P$. Prove the tangent at $P$ bisects $BC$, and find the part cut off if $BC = 10$ cm.

topics.name: Circle touching the sides of a figure

patterns.pattern: Fourth side of a circumscribed quadrilateral

patterns.pattern: Opposite-side sum from the perimeter of a circumscribed quadrilateral
patterns.sample: A quadrilateral $ABCD$ circumscribes a circle and has perimeter $52$ cm. Then $AB + CD$ is:

patterns.pattern: Identify a side from a sum of tangent segments
patterns.sample: $PQRS$ circumscribes a circle, touching $PQ$ at $A$ and $RS$ at $C$. If $PS = 11$ cm, then $PA + CS$ is:

patterns.pattern: Type or perimeter of a parallelogram around a circle
patterns.sample: A parallelogram circumscribes a circle, and one side is $6$ cm. Its perimeter is:

patterns.pattern: Tangent segment or side of a triangle with an incircle
patterns.sample: The incircle of $\triangle ABC$ touches $BC$ at $D$. If $AB = 10$ cm, $BC = 12$ cm and $CA = 8$ cm, then $BD$ is:

patterns.pattern: Inradius of a right triangle
patterns.sample: A circle is inscribed in a right triangle with sides $5$ cm, $12$ cm and $13$ cm. Its radius is:

patterns.pattern: Assertion-reason on a circumscribed figure
patterns.sample: A: A parallelogram circumscribing a circle with one side $7$ cm has perimeter $28$ cm. R: A parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.

patterns.pattern: Prove the opposite-side sums of a circumscribed quadrilateral are equal, short form
patterns.sample: A quadrilateral $ABCD$ circumscribes a circle. Prove that $AB + CD = BC + DA$.

patterns.pattern: Prove the tangent to an excircle is half the perimeter, short form
patterns.sample: A circle touches $BC$ at $P$ and $AB$, $AC$ produced at $Q$, $R$. Prove that $AQ$ is half the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$, and find $AQ$ for sides $8$, $6$, $10$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Segments or sides of a triangle from its incircle
patterns.sample: The incircle of $\triangle ABC$ touches $BC$, $CA$, $AB$ at $D$, $E$, $F$. If $AB = 12$ cm, $BC = 8$ cm and $CA = 10$ cm, find $AF$, $BD$ and $CE$.

patterns.pattern: Prove a circumscribed parallelogram is a rhombus
patterns.sample: Prove that a parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus, and find its side if its perimeter is $36$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Prove opposite sides of a circumscribed quadrilateral subtend supplementary angles at the centre
patterns.sample: A quadrilateral $ABCD$ circumscribes a circle with centre $O$. Prove that $\angle AOB + \angle COD = 180^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Prove the side-sum rule for a circumscribed polygon
patterns.sample: Prove that $AB + CD = AD + BC$ for a quadrilateral circumscribing a circle. Hence find $AD$ if $AB = 8$ cm, $BC = 7$ cm and $CD = 6$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Prove a circumscribed rectangle is a square and find its perimeter
patterns.sample: A rectangle circumscribes a circle of radius $4$ cm. Prove that it is a square and find its perimeter.

patterns.pattern: Inradius of a right triangle with a tangent segment
patterns.sample: A circle is inscribed in $\triangle ABC$, right-angled at $B$, with $AB = 7$ cm and $BC = 24$ cm. Find its radius and the tangent length from $A$.

patterns.pattern: Reverse right-triangle incircle: radius and sides from the hypotenuse segments
patterns.sample: The incircle of $\triangle ABC$, right-angled at $B$, touches $AC$ at $E$. If $AE = 3$ cm and $CE = 10$ cm, find the radius, $AB$ and $BC$.

patterns.pattern: Radius or a side of a circumscribed quadrilateral with a right angle
patterns.sample: $ABCD$ circumscribes a circle, touching $BC$ at $Q$, with $\angle A = 90^\circ$, $AB = 18$ cm, $BC = 15$ cm, $CD = 9$ cm, $DA = 12$ cm and $BQ = 12$ cm. Find the radius.

patterns.pattern: Prove a tangent to an excircle is half the perimeter
patterns.sample: A circle touches $QR$ at $L$ and $PQ$, $PR$ produced at $M$, $N$. Prove that $PM$ is half the perimeter of $\triangle PQR$, and find $PM$ if the sides are $7$, $5$, $6$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Tangent segments of an incircle by formula, or the isosceles midpoint
patterns.sample: In $\triangle ABC$, $AB = AC = 10$ cm and $BC = 12$ cm. The incircle touches $BC$ at $D$ and $AB$ at $P$. Show that $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$, and find $AP$.

patterns.pattern: Sides of a triangle around an incircle from the radius, segments and area
patterns.sample: A circle of radius $3$ cm is inscribed in $\triangle ABC$, touching $BC$ at $D$. If $BD = 6$ cm, $DC = 9$ cm and the area is $54\text{ cm}^2$, find $AB$ and $AC$.

patterns.pattern: Prove the right-triangle inradius formula or solve a right-angled trapezium around a circle
patterns.sample: For an incircle of radius $r$ in $\triangle ABC$, right-angled at $B$, prove $r = \frac{AB + BC - AC}{2}$. Hence find $r$ and $AP$ if $AB = 20$ cm and $BC = 15$ cm.

patterns.pattern: Common tangent of two circles: parallel radii and lengths
patterns.sample: A line from $T$ touches circles with centres $M$, $N$ at $Q$, $B$. If $MQ = 12$ cm, $NB = 4$ cm and $BQ = 15$ cm, prove $MQ \parallel NB$ and find $TB$ and $MN$.

patterns.pattern: Case study: circular region inside a triangular plot
patterns.sample: A round pit of radius $r$ lies inside a right triangular yard with sides $12$, $16$, $20$ m. (i) Name the shape formed at the right angle. (ii) Relate the tangent segments. (iii) Find $r$.

patterns.pattern: Case study: quadrilateral frame around a circular object
patterns.sample: Cloth round poles $A$, $B$, $C$, $D$ touches a round fountain. (i) Angle between cloth and radius. (ii) Shape if $AB = AD$. (iii) $AP$ if $AD = 10$ m and $DR = 6$ m.

patterns.pattern: Case study: tangent throw combined with a circumscribed figure
patterns.sample: A ball on a $3$ m rope traces a circle. (i) Diameter. (ii) Tangent from a point $5$ m from the centre. (iii) Sticks round the circle have $AB = 7$, $BC = 8$, $CD = 6$ m; find $DA$.

patterns.sample: Draw a circle of radius $4$ cm and construct two tangents inclined to each other at $60^\circ$.

patterns.pattern: Divide a line segment internally in a given ratio by construction
patterns.sample: Draw a line segment $AB = 7.6$ cm and divide it internally in the ratio $5:8$. Measure the two parts.

patterns.pattern: Construct a triangle from given data, then a similar triangle at a given scale factor
patterns.sample: Construct a triangle with sides $5$ cm, $6$ cm and $7$ cm, then construct a triangle similar to it whose sides are $\frac{7}{5}$ of the corresponding sides.
